notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the state survey (index and waypoint page) names this tower; no build date, design, staffing, fire, or removal date was found, and the story says nothing about them. The 1976 list PDF linked from the survey (tnlandforms /towers/state.pdf) returned no readable text. The Forest Lookouts list (easternuslookouts) does not name Cope Mountain, so it is not cited. A directory listing (not read) gives the peak a Fire Tower Rd address in McMinnville; unverified and left out. Search budget used (two searches). The agency is inferred from the survey's note that district-tower numbers are Division of Forestry sites.
